// ENGINE INTERFACES
// â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â” export interface EngineError { code: string; message: string; stack?: string; context?: Record<string, any>;
} export interface EngineExecutionResult<T> { ok: boolean; data?: T; errors: EngineError[]; executionTimeMs: number; engineName: string;
} export interface EngineContext { claim: ClaimEntity; logger: ILogger; metrics: IMetricsCollector;
} export interface ILogger { info(message: string, context?: any): void; warn(message: string, context?: any): void; error(message: string, error?: any): void; debug(message: string, context?: any): void;
} export interface IMetricsCollector { recordEngineExecution(engineName: string, result: { success: boolean; executionTimeMs: number; errorCount?: number; }): void;
} # SOURCE: app\frontend-modern\src\engine\domain\evidenceAggregationEngine.js /** * Evidence Aggregation Engine * * Single source of truth for all evidence across all sources. * Handles collection, validation, deduplication, scoring, and access patterns. * * Key responsibilities: * - Centralize evidence from STR, treatment, service, rating decision * - Deduplicate evidence automatically * - Score evidence strength by source and type * - Identify evidence gaps * - Provide evidence by condition access */ import { EvidenceCollection, EvidenceItem, EvidenceSource, EvidenceType, EvidenceStrengthScore, MissingEvidenceItem, EvidenceGap, Result, Ok, Err, EngineExecutionResult,
} from './claimDomainModel.js'; // â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”
// EVIDENCE REQUIREMENTS BY CONDITION
// â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â” const EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENTS = { 'PTSD': [ { type: 'DIAGNOSIS', priority: 'CRITICAL' }, { type: 'DEPLOYMENT_RECORD', priority: 'CRITICAL' }, { type: 'TREATMENT_RECORD', priority: 'HIGH' }, { type: 'FUNCTIONAL_LIMITATION', priority: 'HIGH' }, ], 'TINNITUS': [ { type: 'DIAGNOSIS', priority: 'CRITICAL' }, { type: 'TREATMENT_RECORD', priority: 'HIGH' }, { type: 'EXPOSURE', priority: 'MEDIUM' }, ], 'MIGRAINE': [ { type: 'DIAGNOSIS', priority: 'CRITICAL' }, { type: 'TREATMENT_RECORD', priority: 'HIGH' }, { type: 'FUNCTIONAL_LIMITATION', priority: 'MEDIUM' }, ],
}; // â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”
// NORMALIZATION HELPERS
// â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â” function normalizeText(text) { return String(text || '') .toLowerCase() .trim() .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g, ' ') .replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
} function normalizeConditionName(name) { return normalizeText(name);
} function createEvidenceDeduplicationKey(item) { return [ item.source, item.type, normalizeText(item.text), item.conditionName, item.date || 'nodate', ].join('::').toLowerCase();
} // â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”
// EVIDENCE AGGREGATION ENGINE
// â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â” export class EvidenceAggregationEngine { private collection = this.createEmptyCollection(); /** * Create empty collection structure */ private createEmptyCollection() { return { bySource: new Map(), byCondition: new Map(), missing: [], gaps: [], score: { overall: 0, bySource: new Map(), byType: new Map(), }, lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString(), }; } /** * Add evidence from a source * @returns Result with success/failure */ addEvidence(source, items) { if (!Array.isArray(items)) { return Err(`Invalid items: expected array but got ${typeof items}`); } if (items.length === 0) { return Ok({}); } // Validate evidence items const validation = this.validateEvidence(items); if (!validation.ok) { return validation; } try { // Deduplicate const uniqueItems = this.deduplicate(items); // Add to bySource collection if (!this.collection.bySource.has(source)) { this.collection.bySource.set(source, []); } this.collection.bySource.get(source).push(...uniqueItems); // Index by condition uniqueItems.forEach(item => { const key = normalizeConditionName(item.conditionName); if (!this.collection.byCondition.has(key)) { this.collection.byCondition.set(key, []); } this.collection.byCondition.get(key).push(item); }); // Recalculate derived data this.collection.missing = this.calculateMissingEvidence(); this.collection.gaps = this.calculateEvidenceGaps(); this.recalculateScores(); this.collection.lastUpdated = new Date().toISOString(); return Ok({ itemsAdded: uniqueItems.length, duplicatesRemoved: items.length - uniqueItems.length, }); } catch (error) { return Err(`Failed to add evidence: ${error.message}`); } } /** * Get all evidence for a specific condition */ getEvidenceFor(conditionName) { const key = normalizeConditionName(conditionName); return this.collection.byCondition.get(key) || []; } /** * Get all evidence from a specific source */ getEvidenceBySource(source) { return this.collection.bySource.get(source) || []; } /** * Get missing evidence for a condition */ getMissingEvidence(conditionName) { const requirements = EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENTS[conditionName] || []; const current = this.getEvidenceFor(conditionName); return requirements .filter(req => { const hasRequired = current.some(item => item.type === req.type && item.status === 'ACCEPTED' ); return !hasRequired; }) .map(req => ({ type: req.type, conditionName, reason: `Missing ${req.type.replace(/_/g, ' ').toLowerCase()}`, priority: req.priority, howToObtain: this.getHowToObtainGuidance(req.type), estimatedCost: this.getEstimatedCost(req.type), })); } /** * Get current collection */ getCollection() { return { ...this.collection }; } /** * Export for storage/transmission */ toJSON() { return { bySource: Array.from(this.collection.bySource.entries()).map(([source, items]) => ({ source, items, })), byCondition: Array.from(this.collection.byCondition.entries()).map(([condition, items]) => ({ condition, itemCount: items.length, })), missing: this.collection.missing, gaps: this.collection.gaps, score: { overall: this.collection.score.overall, bySource: Array.from(this.collection.score.bySource.entries()), byType: Array.from(this.collection.score.byType.entries()), }, lastUpdated: this.collection.lastUpdated, }; } // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â• // PRIVATE METHODS // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â• /** * Validate evidence items for correctness */ private validateEvidence(items) { const errors = []; items.forEach((item, index) => { if (!item.source) { errors.push(`Item ${index}: Missing source`); } if (!item.type) { errors.push(`Item ${index}: Missing type`); } if (!item.text) { errors.push(`Item ${index}: Missing text`); } if (!item.conditionName) { errors.push(`Item ${index}: Missing conditionName`); } if (!Number.isFinite(item.confidence) || item.confidence < 0 || item.confidence > 100) { errors.push(`Item ${index}: Invalid confidence (must be 0-100)`); } }); if (errors.length > 0) { return Err(`Evidence validation failed:\n${errors.join('\n')}`); } return Ok(); } /** * Remove duplicate evidence items */ private deduplicate(items) { const seen = new Set(); const unique = []; items.forEach(item => { const key = createEvidenceDeduplicationKey(item); if (!seen.has(key)) { seen.add(key); unique.push(item); } }); return unique; } /** * Calculate missing evidence */ private calculateMissingEvidence() { const missing = []; const conditions = new Set( Array.from(this.collection.byCondition.keys()) ); conditions.forEach(conditionKey => { const original = Array.from(EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENTS.keys()).find( key => normalizeConditionName(key) === conditionKey ); if (original) { missing.push(...this.getMissingEvidence(original)); } }); return missing; } /** * Calculate evidence gaps (conditions with weak evidence) */ private calculateEvidenceGaps() { const gaps = []; this.collection.byCondition.forEach((items, conditionKey) => { const sourceCount = new Set(items.map(i => i.source)).size; const avgConfidence = items.reduce((sum, i) => sum + i.confidence, 0) / items.length; const typeCount = new Set(items.map(i => i.type)).size; // Flag as gap if meets criteria if (sourceCount < 2 && avgConfidence < 70) { gaps.push({ conditionName: conditionKey, missingTypes: [], severity: 'HIGH', recommendation: 'Gather evidence from additional sources', }); } else if (typeCount < 2 && avgConfidence < 60) { gaps.push({ conditionName: conditionKey, missingTypes: [], severity: 'MEDIUM', recommendation: 'Include multiple types of evidence', }); } }); return gaps; } /** * Recalculate all evidence scores */ private recalculateScores() { const sourceScores = new Map(); const typeScores = new Map(); // Calculate by source let totalSourceScore = 0; let sourceCount = 0; this.collection.bySource.forEach((items, source) => { const score = this.scoreSourceEvidence(items); sourceScores.set(source, score); totalSourceScore += score; sourceCount++; }); // Calculate by type let totalTypeScore = 0; let typeCount = 0; this.collection.byCondition.forEach(items => { items.forEach(item => { if (!typeScores.has(item.type)) { typeScores.set(item.type, []); } typeScores.get(item.type).push(item.confidence); }); }); typeScores.forEach((scores, type) => { const avgScore = scores.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / scores.length; typeScores.set(type, Math.round(avgScore)); totalTypeScore += avgScore; typeCount++; }); const overall = Math.round( (totalSourceScore / Math.max(1, sourceCount) + totalTypeScore / Math.max(1, typeCount)) / 2 ); this.collection.score = { overall: Math.min(100, overall), bySource: sourceScores, byType: typeScores, }; } /** * Score evidence from a single source */ private scoreSourceEvidence(items) { if (!items || items.length === 0) return 0; // Base score on count let score = Math.min(30, items.length * 5); // Boost for accepted items const acceptedCount = items.filter(i => i.status === 'ACCEPTED').length; score += (acceptedCount / items.length) * 40; // Boost for average confidence const avgConfidence = items.reduce((sum, i) => sum + i.confidence, 0) / items.length; score += (avgConfidence / 100) * 30; return Math.round(Math.min(100, score)); } /** * Get guidance on how to obtain evidence */ private getHowToObtainGuidance(type) { const guidance = { DIAGNOSIS: 'Request medical records from healthcare providers', TREATMENT_RECORD: 'Obtain treatment summaries from medical facilities', DEPLOYMENT_RECORD: 'Copy from DD-214 or request from NPRC', EXPOSURE: 'Provide details of deployment locations and events', FUNCTIONAL_LIMITATION: 'Request evaluation from healthcare provider', SERVICE_CONNECTION: 'Available in existing VA records', DENIAL_REASON: 'Available in VA decision letters', }; return guidance[type] || 'Contact VA Benefits Advisor'; } /** * Get estimated cost for evidence */ private getEstimatedCost(type) { const costs = { DIAGNOSIS: 'FREE', TREATMENT_RECORD: '$25-100', DEPLOYMENT_RECORD: 'FREE', EXPOSURE: 'FREE', FUNCTIONAL_LIMITATION: '$200-500', SERVICE_CONNECTION: 'FREE', DENIAL_REASON: 'FREE', }; return costs[type] || 'Varies'; }
} // â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”
// ENGINE INTEGRATION
// â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â” export async function runEvidenceAggregationEngine(input) { const startTime = performance.now(); const errors = []; try { const engine = new EvidenceAggregationEngine(); // Add evidence from each source if (input.strEvidence) { const result = engine.addEvidence('STR', input.strEvidence); if (!result.ok) errors.push(result.error); } if (input.treatmentEvidence) { const result = engine.addEvidence('TREATMENT', input.treatmentEvidence); if (!result.ok) errors.push(result.error); } if (input.serviceEvidence) { const result = engine.addEvidence('SERVICE', input.serviceEvidence); if (!result.ok) errors.push(result.error); } if (input.ratingDecisionEvidence) { const result = engine.addEvidence('RATING_DECISION', input.ratingDecisionEvidence); if (!result.ok) errors.push(result.error); } return { ok: errors.length === 0, data: engine.getCollection(), errors: errors.map(e => ({ code: 'EVIDENCE_AGGREGATION_ERROR', message: e, })), executionTimeMs: performance.now() - startTime, engineName: 'EvidenceAggregationEngine', }; } catch (error) { return { ok: false, errors: [{ code: 'ENGINE_ERROR', message: error.message, stack: error.stack, }], executionTimeMs: performance.now() - startTime, engineName: 'EvidenceAggregationEngine', }; }

// VALIDATION PIPELINE
// â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â” export class ValidationPipeline { private rules: Map<string, ValidationRule> = new Map(); private enabledRules: Set<string>; constructor(enabledRules?: string[]) { this.enabledRules = new Set(enabledRules || Object.keys(VALIDATION_RULES)); } register(name: string, rule: ValidationRule): void { this.rules.set(name, rule); this.enabledRules.add(name); } enable(...ruleNames: string[]): void { ruleNames.forEach(name => this.enabledRules.add(name)); } disable(...ruleNames: string[]): void { ruleNames.forEach(name => this.enabledRules.delete(name)); } async run(claim: ClaimEntity): Promise<ValidationResult> { const errors: ValidationError[] = []; const warnings: ValidationWarning[] = []; for (const [ruleName, rule] of this.rules) { if (!this.enabledRules.has(ruleName)) continue; try { const results = rule.validate(claim); if (rule.severity === 'ERROR') { errors.push(...results); } else { warnings.push(...results); } } catch (error) { errors.push({ code: 'VALIDATION_RULE_ERROR', message: `Validation rule "${ruleName}" encountered an error: ${error.message}`, }); } } const completeness = this.scoreCompleteness(claim); const readiness = this.scoreReadiness(claim, errors, warnings); return { isValid: errors.length === 0, errors, warnings, completeness, readiness, validatedAt: new Date().toISOString(), }; } private scoreCompleteness(claim: ClaimEntity): CompletenessScore { let profileScore = 0; let serviceScore = 0; let medicalScore = 0; let evidenceScore = 0; // Profile completeness (0-25) const profile = claim.profile; if (profile.firstName) profileScore += 5; if (profile.lastName) profileScore += 5; if (profile.dateOfBirth) profileScore += 5; if (profile.ssnLast4) profileScore += 5; if (profile.email && profile.phone) profileScore += 5; // Service completeness (0-25) if (claim.data.service && claim.data.service.length > 0) { serviceScore += 10; if (claim.data.service.some(s => s.combatStatus)) serviceScore += 5; if (claim.data.service.some(s => s.deploymentLocations?.length)) serviceScore += 5; if (claim.data.service.some(s => s.primaryMOS)) serviceScore += 5; } // Medical completeness (0-25) const med = claim.data.medicalRecords; if (med.diagnoses?.length) medicalScore += 8; if (med.currentConditions?.length) medicalScore += 8; if (med.treatmentEvents?.length) medicalScore += 9; // Evidence completeness (0-25) const evidenceCount = Array.from(claim.evidence.bySource.values()) .reduce((sum, items) => sum + items.length, 0); if (evidenceCount > 0) evidenceScore += 8; if (evidenceCount > 10) evidenceScore += 8; if (claim.evidence.bySource.size > 1) evidenceScore += 9; const overall = Math.round((profileScore + serviceScore + medicalScore + evidenceScore) / 4); return { overall: Math.min(100, overall), profile: profileScore, service: serviceScore, medical: medicalScore, evidence: evidenceScore, }; } private scoreReadiness( claim: ClaimEntity, errors: ValidationError[], warnings: ValidationWarning[] ): ReadinessScore { const blockers: string[] = []; const recommendations: string[] = []; // Check for critical blockers if (errors.length > 0) { blockers.push(`${errors.length} validation error(s) must be resolved`); } if (claim.evidence.gaps.length > 0) { blockers.push(`${claim.evidence.gaps.length} evidence gap(s) need attention`); } if (!claim.generated.conditions || claim.generated.conditions.length === 0) { blockers.push('No conditions have been identified'); } // Add recommendations from warnings warnings.forEach(warning => { if (warning.suggestion) { recommendations.push(warning.suggestion); } }); const canFile = blockers.length === 0 && errors.length === 0; let recommendedIn = 0; if (!canFile) { recommendedIn = Math.min(30, blokers.length * 7); // Days to wait } return { overall: canFile ? 100 : Math.max(0, 100 - (blockers.length * 20)), canFile, recommendedIn, blockers, recommendations, }; }
} // â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”
// DEFAULT PIPELINE INSTANCE
// â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â”â” export function createDefaultValidationPipeline(): ValidationPipeline { const pipeline = new ValidationPipeline(); // Register all default rules Object.entries(VALIDATION_RULES).forEach(([name, rule]) => { pipeline.register(name, rule); }); return pipeline;

} from '../shared/normalizationRegistry.js'; const ENGINE_VERSION = '1.1.0'; function selectEvidenceForCondition(conditionName, veteranProfile = {}) { const key = normalizeVeteranProfileKey(conditionName); const inService = uniqueStrings([ ...asList(veteranProfile?.medicalHistory?.inServiceDiagnoses).filter((item) => normalizeVeteranProfileKey(item) === key), ...asList(veteranProfile?.medicalHistory?.inServiceInjuries).filter((item) => normalizeVeteranProfileKey(item) === key), ...asList(veteranProfile?.medicalHistory?.inServiceEvents).filter((item) => normalizeVeteranProfileKey(item) === key), ...asList(veteranProfile?.medicalHistory?.inServiceEntries) .filter((entry) => normalizeVeteranProfileKey(entry?.conditionName) === key) .map((entry) => `${asText(entry?.eventDate)} ${asText(entry?.description)}`.trim()), ]); const current = uniqueStrings([ ...asList(veteranProfile?.medicalHistory?.currentConditions).filter((item) => normalizeVeteranProfileKey(item) === key), ...asList(veteranProfile?.medicalHistory?.currentTreatmentEntries) .filter((entry) => normalizeVeteranProfileKey(entry?.conditionName) === key) .map((entry) => `${asText(entry?.providerName)} ${asText(entry?.treatmentDetails)}`.trim()), ...asList(veteranProfile?.medicalHistory?.evidenceSnippets).filter((item) => normalizeVeteranProfileKey(item).includes(key) || key.includes(normalizeVeteranProfileKey(item))), ]); const service = uniqueStrings([ ...asList(veteranProfile?.militaryService?.likelyExposures), ...asList(veteranProfile?.militaryService?.hazardPayIndicators), ...asList(veteranProfile?.militaryService?.deployments), ]); const rating = uniqueStrings([ ...asList(veteranProfile?.benefits?.currentRatings) .filter((entry) => normalizeVeteranProfileKey(entry?.conditionName) === key) .map((entry) => `${entry.conditionName} ${entry.percentage ? } # SOURCE: app\frontend-modern\src\engine\orchestration\claimOrchestrator.js /** * Claim Orchestrator * * Top-level pipeline coordinator that sequences all sub-engines and transitions * the ClaimEntity through its workflow stages. * * Pipeline: * Stage 1 â€” Normalize input data * Stage 2 â€” Aggregate evidence from all sources * Stage 3 â€” Generate conditions * Stage 4 â€” Generate lay statement * Stage 5 â€” Run validation pipeline * Stage 6 â€” Transition workflow state * * Usage: * const orchestrator = new ClaimOrchestrator(); * const result = await orchestrator.processClaim(claimDataUnified, options); * if (result.ok) { * const { claim, validation, snapshot } = result.value; * } */ import { createClaimWorkflowMachine, STAGES } from './claimWorkflowMachine.js';
import { BaseEngine } from './baseEngine.js'; // â”€â”€â”€ Stage 1: Normalization Engine â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ class NormalizationEngine extends BaseEngine { get name() { return 'NormalizationEngine'; } validateInput(input) { const errors = []; if (!input) errors.push('input is required'); return errors; } async executeInternal(input, _ctx) { const profile = normalizeProfile(input.profile || {}, input); const serviceHistory = normalizeServiceHistory(input.service || []); const medicalRecords = normalizeMedicalRecords(input.currentTreatment || {}); const ratingHistory = normalizeRatingHistory(input.ratingDecision || {}); return { ...input, _normalized: { profile, serviceHistory, medicalRecords, ratingHistory, normalizedAt: stateNowIso(input), }, }; }
} // â”€â”€â”€ Stage 2: Evidence Aggregation Engine â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ class EvidenceStageEngine extends BaseEngine { get name() { return 'EvidenceStageEngine'; } validateInput(input) { if (!input._normalized) return ['NormalizationEngine must run first']; return []; } async executeInternal(input, ctx) { const { serviceHistory, medicalRecords, ratingHistory } = input._normalized; // Collect raw evidence items from all sources const evidenceBySource = { SERVICE: extractServiceEvidence(serviceHistory), STR: extractStrEvidence(input.str || {}), TREATMENT: extractTreatmentEvidence(medicalRecords), RATING_DECISION: extractRatingEvidence(ratingHistory), }; // Deduplicate across sources const allEvidence = []; const seen = new Set(); Object.entries(evidenceBySource).forEach(([source, items]) => { items.forEach(item => { const key = `${source}::${item.type}::${normalizeText(item.text)}::${item.conditionName || ''}`; if (!seen.has(key)) { seen.add(key); allEvidence.push({ ...item, source, id: buildStableId('ev', `${allEvidence.length}_${key}`) }); } }); }); // Index by condition const byCondition = {}; allEvidence.forEach(item => { const key = normalizeText(item.conditionName || 'general'); if (!byCondition[key]) byCondition[key] = []; byCondition[key].push(item); }); ctx.logger.info(`EvidenceStageEngine: aggregated ${allEvidence.length} evidence items across ${Object.keys(byCondition).length} conditions`); return { ...input, _evidence: { bySource: evidenceBySource, byCondition, all: allEvidence, count: allEvidence.length, aggregatedAt: stateNowIso(input), }, }; }
} // â”€â”€â”€ Stage 3: Condition Generator Adapter â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ class ConditionGeneratorStageEngine extends BaseEngine { get name() { return 'ConditionGeneratorStageEngine'; } validateInput(input) { if (!input._evidence) return ['EvidenceStageEngine must run first']; return []; } async executeInternal(input, ctx) { // Use existing conditionGenerator engine if available, otherwise derive from evidence let conditions = []; try { // Dynamically import existing engine to avoid circular deps const mod = await import('../conditionGenerator/index.js').catch(() => null); if (mod && mod.generateConditions) { conditions = await mod.generateConditions(input) || []; } } catch (err) { ctx.logger.warn(`ConditionGeneratorStageEngine: existing engine unavailable, deriving from evidence: ${err.message}`); } // If no conditions from legacy engine, derive from evidence if (!conditions.length) { conditions = deriveConditionsFromEvidence(input._evidence.byCondition); } ctx.logger.info(`ConditionGeneratorStageEngine: produced ${conditions.length} conditions`); return { ...input, _conditions: { items: conditions, count: conditions.length, generatedAt: stateNowIso(input), }, }; }
} // â”€â”€â”€ Stage 4: Lay Statement Engine Adapter â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ class LayStatementStageEngine extends BaseEngine { get name() { return 'LayStatementStageEngine'; } validateInput(input) { if (!input._conditions) return ['ConditionGeneratorStageEngine must run first']; return []; } async executeInternal(input, ctx) { let layStatement = null; try { const mod = await import('../layStatement/index.js').catch(() => null); if (mod && mod.generateLayStatement) { layStatement = await mod.generateLayStatement(input) || null; } } catch (err) { ctx.logger.warn(`LayStatementStageEngine: existing engine unavailable: ${err.message}`); } if (!layStatement && input._conditions.count > 0) { layStatement = buildFallbackLayStatement(input._normalized.profile, input._conditions.items, input); } return { ...input, _layStatement: layStatement, }; }
} // â”€â”€â”€ Stage 5: Validation Stage â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ class ValidationStageEngine extends BaseEngine { get name() { return 'ValidationStageEngine'; } async executeInternal(input, ctx) { let validationResult = null; try { const mod = await import('../domain/validationPipeline.js').catch(() => null); if (mod && mod.createDefaultValidationPipeline) { // Build a ClaimEntity shape from accumulated pipeline state const claimEntity = buildClaimEntityFromPipeline(input); const pipeline = mod.createDefaultValidationPipeline(); validationResult = await pipeline.run(claimEntity); } } catch (err) { ctx.logger.warn(`ValidationStageEngine: pipeline unavailable: ${err.message}`); } if (!validationResult) { validationResult = { isValid: true, errors: [], warnings: [], completeness: { overall: 50 } }; } ctx.logger.info(`ValidationStageEngine: valid=${validationResult.isValid}, errors=${validationResult.errors.length}, warnings=${validationResult.warnings.length}`); return { ...input, _validation: validationResult, }; }
} // â”€â”€â”€ Stage 6: Workflow Transition Stage â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ class WorkflowTransitionStageEngine extends BaseEngine { get name() { return 'WorkflowTransitionStageEngine'; } async executeInternal(input, ctx) { const claimEntity = buildClaimEntityFromPipeline(input); const machine = createClaimWorkflowMachine(claimEntity); // Advance through stages as far as the data supports const transitions = []; if (machine.currentStage === STAGES.NEW) { const r = machine.transition(STAGES.ANALYZING, 'Normalization complete'); transitions.push(r); } if (machine.currentStage === STAGES.ANALYZING && (input._normalized?.serviceHistory || []).length > 0) { const r = machine.transition(STAGES.EVIDENCE_GATHERING, 'Service history present'); transitions.push(r); } if (machine.currentStage === STAGES.EVIDENCE_GATHERING && (input._conditions?.count || 0) > 0) { const r = machine.transition(STAGES.READY, 'Conditions generated'); transitions.push(r); } if (machine.currentStage === STAGES.READY) { const evidenceCount = (input._evidence?.count || 0); if (evidenceCount > 0) { const r = machine.transition(STAGES.PACKAGED, 'Evidence aggregated and packaged'); transitions.push(r); } } const validation = input._validation || {}; if (machine.currentStage === STAGES.PACKAGED && input._layStatement && (validation.errors || []).length === 0) { const r = machine.transition(STAGES.ACTIVE, 'Lay statement present, validation passed'); transitions.push(r); } ctx.logger.info(`WorkflowTransitionStageEngine: final stage = ${machine.currentStage} (${transitions.length} transitions applied)`); return { ...input, _workflow: { stage: machine.currentStage, transitions, snapshot: machine.toSnapshot(), processedAt: stateNowIso(input), }, }; }
} // â”€â”€â”€ Orchestrator â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ export class ClaimOrchestrator { constructor(options = {}) { this._stages = [ new NormalizationEngine(), new EvidenceStageEngine(), new ConditionGeneratorStageEngine(), new LayStatementStageEngine(), new ValidationStageEngine(), new WorkflowTransitionStageEngine(), ]; this._logger = options.logger || { info: (...a) => console.info('[ClaimOrchestrator]', ...a), warn: (...a) => console.warn('[ClaimOrchestrator]', ...a), error: (...a) => console.error('[ClaimOrchestrator]', ...a), debug: (...a) => { if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') console.debug('[ClaimOrchestrator]', ...a); }, }; } /** * Process a claim through the full pipeline. * * @param {object} claimDataUnified - The unified claim data from state * @param {object} [options={}] - Runtime options (veteranId, traceId, etc.) * @returns {Promise<OrchestratorResult>} */ async processClaim(claimDataUnified, options = {}) { const deterministic = Boolean(options.deterministic); const startTime = deterministic ? 0 : Date.now(); const traceId = options.traceId || buildStableId('orch', deterministic ? claimDataUnified : Date.now()); this._logger.info(`Starting claim processing [traceId=${traceId}]`); const context = { traceId, veteranId: claimDataUnified?.profile?.veteranId || options.veteranId || 'unknown', logger: this._logger, deterministic, }; let current = { ...claimDataUnified, _traceId: traceId, _deterministic: deterministic }; const stageResults = []; // Run all stages in sequence for (const stage of this._stages) { const result = await stage.run(current, context); stageResults.push({ stage: stage.name, ok: result.ok, durationMs: result.durationMs, error: result.error }); if (!result.ok) { this._logger.error(`Pipeline halted at stage "${stage.name}": ${result.error}`); return { ok: false, error: result.error, stage: stage.name, traceId, durationMs: deterministic ? 0 : (Date.now() - startTime), stageResults, }; } current = result.value; } // Build final output const claim = buildFinalClaimEntity(current); const totalMs = deterministic ? 0 : (Date.now() - startTime); this._logger.info(`Claim processing complete [traceId=${traceId}] in ${totalMs}ms, stage=${claim.processingStage}`); return { ok: true, value: { claim, validation: current._validation || null, workflow: current._workflow || null, evidence: current._evidence || null, conditions: current._conditions?.items || [], layStatement: current._layStatement || null, }, traceId, durationMs: totalMs, stageResults, }; }
} export function createClaimOrchestrator(options = {}) { return new ClaimOrchestrator(options);
} // â”€â”€â”€ Internal Normalization Helpers â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ function normalizeProfile(profile = {}) { const firstName = String(profile.firstName || '').trim(); const lastName = String(profile.lastName || '').trim(); return { ...profile, firstName, lastName, fullName: [firstName, lastName].filter(Boolean).join(' '), veteranId: profile.veteranId || buildStableId('v', `${firstName}_${lastName}`), };
} function normalizeServiceHistory(service = []) { return (Array.isArray(service) ? service : []).map((rec, i) => ({ id: rec.id || `svc_${i}`, branchOfService: String(rec.branchOfService || rec.branch || '').trim(), serviceType: String(rec.serviceType || '').trim(), startDate: rec.startDate || rec.entryDate || null, endDate: rec.endDate || rec.separationDate || null, rankRate: rec.rankRate || rec.rank || null, dischargeType: rec.dischargeType || rec.characterOfDischarge || 'Unknown', primaryMOS: rec.primaryMOS || rec.mos || null, combatVeteran: Boolean(rec.combatVeteran || rec.combatStatus), deploymentLocations: Array.isArray(rec.deploymentLocations) ? rec.deploymentLocations : [], hazardPayIndicators: Array.isArray(rec.hazardPayIndicators) ? rec.hazardPayIndicators : [], }));
} function normalizeMedicalRecords(treatment = {}) { const extracted = treatment.extractedFindings || {}; return { diagnoses: asStringList(extracted.diagnoses || treatment.diagnoses), currentConditions: asStringList(extracted.currentConditions || treatment.currentConditions), medications: asStringList(extracted.medications || treatment.medications), treatmentEvents: asArray(extracted.treatmentEvents || treatment.treatmentEvents), manualEntries: asArray(treatment.manualEntries), };
} function normalizeRatingHistory(ratingDecision = {}) { const extracted = ratingDecision.extractedFindings || {}; return { serviceConnectedConditions: asArray(extracted.serviceConnectedConditions || []), deniedConditions: asArray(extracted.deniedConditions || []), combinedRating: extracted.combinedRating || ratingDecision.combinedRating || null, effectiveDates: asArray(extracted.effectiveDates || []), manualEntries: asArray(ratingDecision.manualEntries || []), };
} // â”€â”€â”€ Evidence Extraction Helpers â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ function extractServiceEvidence(serviceHistory = []) { const items = []; serviceHistory.forEach(rec => { if (rec.combatVeteran) items.push({ type: 'SERVICE_CONNECTION', conditionName: 'general', text: 'Combat service documented', confidence: 80 }); (rec.deploymentLocations || []).forEach(loc => items.push({ type: 'DEPLOYMENT_RECORD', conditionName: 'general', text: `Deployment: ${loc}`, confidence: 75 })); (rec.hazardPayIndicators || []).forEach(h => items.push({ type: 'EXPOSURE', conditionName: 'general', text: `Hazard pay indicator: ${h}`, confidence: 70 })); }); return items;
} function extractStrEvidence(str = {}) { const extracted = str.extractedFindings || {}; const items = []; asStringList(extracted.diagnoses).forEach(d => items.push({ type: 'DIAGNOSIS', conditionName: normalizeText(d), text: `STR diagnosis: ${d}`, confidence: 85 })); asStringList(extracted.injuries).forEach(i => items.push({ type: 'SYMPTOM', conditionName: normalizeText(i), text: `STR injury: ${i}`, confidence: 80 })); asArray(str.manualEntries || []).forEach(e => items.push({ type: 'TREATMENT_RECORD', conditionName: normalizeText(e.conditionName || 'general'), text: e.description || e.conditionName || '', confidence: 70 })); return items;
} function extractTreatmentEvidence(medicalRecords = {}) { const items = []; asStringList(medicalRecords.diagnoses).forEach(d => items.push({ type: 'DIAGNOSIS', conditionName: normalizeText(d), text: `Current diagnosis: ${d}`, confidence: 90 })); asStringList(medicalRecords.currentConditions).forEach(c => items.push({ type: 'SYMPTOM', conditionName: normalizeText(c), text: `Current condition: ${c}`, confidence: 85 })); asArray(medicalRecords.manualEntries || []).forEach(e => items.push({ type: 'TREATMENT_RECORD', conditionName: normalizeText(e.conditionName || 'general'), text: e.symptomSummary || e.conditionName || '', confidence: 75 })); return items;
} function extractRatingEvidence(ratingHistory = {}) { const items = []; asArray(ratingHistory.serviceConnectedConditions).forEach(c => { const name = typeof c === 'string' ? c : (c.conditionName || c.label || ''); if (name) items.push({ type: 'SERVICE_CONNECTION', conditionName: normalizeText(name), text: `Service connected: ${name}`, confidence: 95 }); }); asArray(ratingHistory.deniedConditions).forEach(c => { const name = typeof c === 'string' ? c : (c.conditionName || c.label || ''); if (name) items.push({ type: 'DENIAL_REASON', conditionName: normalizeText(name), text: `Previously denied: ${name}`, confidence: 90 }); }); return items;
} // â”€â”€â”€ Condition Derivation â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ function deriveConditionsFromEvidence(byCondition = {}) { return Object.entries(byCondition) .filter(([key]) => key !== 'general') .map(([conditionName, evidence], i) => ({ id: `cond_${i}`, name: conditionName, evidence: evidence.map(e => e.text), evidenceCount: evidence.length, confidenceScore: Math.round(evidence.reduce((sum, e) => sum + (e.confidence || 0), 0) / evidence.length), category: 'derived', status: 'generated', }));
} // â”€â”€â”€ Lay Statement Builder â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ function buildFallbackLayStatement(profile = {}, conditions = [], pipelineState = {}) { const name = profile.fullName || [profile.firstName, profile.lastName].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || 'Veteran'; const conditionList = conditions.map(c => c.name || c.conditionName || '').filter(Boolean).join(', '); return { text: `I, ${name}, state that I currently suffer from ${conditionList || 'the conditions listed in this claim'}, which began or worsened during my military service.`, generatedAt: stateNowIso(pipelineState), type: 'fallback', };
} // â”€â”€â”€ ClaimEntity Builder â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ function buildClaimEntityFromPipeline(pipelineState) { return { id: pipelineState._claimId || buildStableId('claim', pipelineState._traceId || pipelineState._normalized?.profile?.veteranId || 'unknown'), veteranId: pipelineState._normalized?.profile?.veteranId || 'unknown', profile: pipelineState._normalized?.profile || pipelineState.profile || {}, serviceHistory: pipelineState._normalized?.serviceHistory || [], medicalRecords: pipelineState._normalized?.medicalRecords || {}, ratingHistory: pipelineState._normalized?.ratingHistory || {}, conditions: pipelineState._conditions?.items || [], evidence: pipelineState._evidence || { bySource: {}, byCondition: {}, all: [], count: 0 }, layStatement: pipelineState._layStatement || null, validation: pipelineState._validation || null, processingStage: pipelineState._workflow?.stage || STAGES.NEW, auditLog: pipelineState._workflow?.transitions?.map(t => ({ ...t, timestamp: t?.timestamp || stateNowIso(pipelineState) })) || [], updatedAt: stateNowIso(pipelineState), };
} function buildFinalClaimEntity(pipelineState) { const entity = buildClaimEntityFromPipeline(pipelineState); entity.processingStage = pipelineState._workflow?.stage || entity.processingStage; return entity;
} // â”€â”€â”€ Utility Helpers â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ function asArray(v) { return Array.isArray(v) ? v : []; }
function asStringList(v) { return asArray(v).map(s => String(s || '').trim()).filter(Boolean); }
function normalizeText(s) { return String(s || '').toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); }
function stateNowIso(state) { return state?._deterministic ? '1970-01-01T00:00:00.000Z' : new Date().toISOString(); }
function buildStableId(prefix, value) { const text = String(value || 'none'); let hash = 0; for (let index = 0; index < text.length; index += 1) { hash = ((hash << 5) - hash) + text.charCodeAt(index); hash |= 0; } return `${prefix}_${Math.abs(hash)}`;
} # SOURCE: app\frontend-modern\src\engine\orchestration\claimOutputSerializer.js /** * Claim Output Serializer * * Canonical output contracts for all claim data leaving the engine pipeline. * Every export function here produces a well-typed, stable shape that the * frontend and backend can depend on without coupling to internal engine state. * * Responsibilities: * - Serialize ClaimEntity â†’ display-ready shapes * - Serialize ClaimEntity â†’ export formats (PDF payload, API payload) * - Generate readiness summaries * - Produce diff-able snapshots for state comparison */ // â”€â”€â”€ Frontend Display Contract â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ /** * Serializes a ClaimEntity into the shape expected by ClaimGeneratorSummaryTab. * * @param {object} claim - ClaimEntity root aggregate * @returns {ClaimDisplayModel} */
export function serializeForDisplay(claim) { if (!claim) return null; return { id: claim.id || null, veteranId: claim.veteranId || null, stage: claim.processingStage || 'NEW', stageLabel: STAGE_LABELS[claim.processingStage] || 'New', isReady: isClaimReady(claim), isBlocked: claim.processingStage === 'BLOCKED', // Profile section profile: serializeProfile(claim.profile), // Service section service: serializeServiceHistory(claim.serviceHistory), // Conditions section conditions: serializeConditions(claim.conditions), // Evidence section evidence: serializeEvidenceSummary(claim.evidence), // Lay statement section layStatement: serializeLayStatement(claim.layStatement), // Validation section validation: serializeValidation(claim.validation), // Workflow section workflow: serializeWorkflow(claim), // Timestamps updatedAt: claim.updatedAt || null, createdAt: claim.createdAt || null, };
} /** * Serializes a ClaimEntity into the shape expected by the backend API endpoint * for claim submission. * * @param {object} claim - ClaimEntity root aggregate * @returns {ClaimApiPayload} */
export function serializeForApi(claim) { if (!claim) return null; return { veteranId: claim.veteranId, processingStage: claim.processingStage, profile: flattenProfile(claim.profile), serviceHistory: (claim.serviceHistory || []).map(flattenServiceRecord), conditions: (claim.conditions || []).map(flattenCondition), evidence: flattenEvidenceCollection(claim.evidence), layStatement: claim.layStatement ? { text: claim.layStatement.text, type: claim.layStatement.type, generatedAt: claim.layStatement.generatedAt, } : null, validation: claim.validation ? { isValid: claim.validation.isValid, errorCount: (claim.validation.errors || []).length, warningCount: (claim.validation.warnings || []).length, completenessScore: claim.validation.completeness?.overall || 0, } : null, submittedAt: new Date().toISOString(), };
} /** * Serializes a ClaimEntity into a minimal snapshot suitable for state comparison * and diff detection (e.g. React memo dependency check). * * @param {object} claim - ClaimEntity root aggregate * @returns {ClaimSnapshot} */
export function serializeSnapshot(claim) { if (!claim) return null; return { id: claim.id, stage: claim.processingStage, conditionCount: (claim.conditions || []).length, evidenceCount: claim.evidence?.count || 0, hasLayStatement: Boolean(claim.layStatement), validationValid: claim.validation?.isValid ?? null, completenessScore: claim.validation?.completeness?.overall ?? 0, updatedAt: claim.updatedAt, };

// in isolation and reused by future export surfaces. import { getLaneRecommendation } from './laneFormMap.js'; export function buildEvidenceIndex(conditionRecords) { const index = new Map(); for (const record of conditionRecords) { const allRefs = [ ...record.sourceEvidence.current, ...record.sourceEvidence.inService, ...record.sourceEvidence.rated, ...record.sourceEvidence.denied, ]; for (const ref of allRefs) { const key = ref.sourceName; if (!index.has(key)) { index.set(key, { sourceName: ref.sourceName, sourceType: ref.sourceType, conditions: new Set() }); } index.get(key).conditions.add(record.condition); } } return Array.from(index.values()).map((entry) => ({ ...entry, conditions: Array.from(entry.conditions) }));
} export function buildCaseSummaryPacket(workflow) { const evidenceIndex = buildEvidenceIndex(workflow.conditionRecords); const evidenceIndexSection = evidenceIndex.length > 0 ? evidenceIndex .map( (entry, i) => ` ${i + 1}. ${entry.sourceName} [${entry.sourceType}]\n Supports: ${entry.conditions.join(', ')}` ) .join('\n') : ' No source documents linked yet. Upload STRs, treatment records, or a VA decision to populate this index.'; const conditionActionPlan = workflow.conditionRecords .map((item, index) => { const laneRec = getLaneRecommendation(item.recommendedLane); const sourceLines = [ ...item.sourceEvidence.current.map((e) => ` Current: ${e.label} [${e.sourceName}]`), ...item.sourceEvidence.inService.map((e) => ` In-service: ${e.label} [${e.sourceName}]`), ...item.sourceEvidence.rated.map((e) => ` Rated: ${e.label} [${e.sourceName}]`), ...item.sourceEvidence.denied.map((e) => ` Denied: ${e.label} [${e.sourceName}]`), ]; return ` ${index + 1}. ${item.condition} Filing Lane: ${item.recommendedLane} Readiness: ${item.readinessState} (${item.readinessScore}%) Reason: ${item.readinessReason} Gaps: ${item.evidenceGaps.length > 0 ? item.evidenceGaps.join('; ') : 'None currently identified'} Score factors:
${item.scoreFactors.map((f) => ` ${f.impact} ${f.label}`).join('\n')} Required forms: ${laneRec.forms.join('\n ')} Action tip: ${laneRec.tip} Linked evidence:
${sourceLines.length > 0 ? sourceLines.join('\n') : ' No source-level evidence linked yet'}`; }) .join('\n\n'); return `RALLY FORGE CASE SUMMARY PACKET
Generated: ${new Date().toLocaleString()}
\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501 SECTION 1 â€” WORKFLOW SNAPSHOT Profile: ${workflow.readiness.profile ? '\u2713 Ready' : '\u25cb Pending'} Military Service: ${workflow.readiness.militaryService ? '\u2713 Ready' : '\u25cb Pending'} STR Evidence: ${workflow.readiness.serviceTreatmentRecords ? '\u2713 Ready' : '\u25cb Pending'} Current Treatment: ${workflow.readiness.currentTreatment ? '\u2713 Ready' : '\u25cb Pending'} VA Decision: ${workflow.readiness.vaDecision ? '\u2713 Ready' : '\u25cb Optional'} Analyzer Inputs: ${workflow.readiness.analyzer ? '\u2713 Ready' : '\u25cb Pending'} SECTION 2 â€” CLAIM SIGNALS Presumptive deployment matches: ${workflow.serviceSummary.presumptiveMatches} Potential new claims identified: ${workflow.potentialNewClaims.length} Denied conditions on decision: ${workflow.vaSummary.deniedConditions.length} Rated conditions on decision: ${workflow.vaSummary.serviceConnectedConditions.length} Condition workspaces assembled: ${workflow.conditionSummary.total} Claim-ready conditions: ${workflow.conditionSummary.claimReadyCount} Developing conditions: ${workflow.conditionSummary.developingCount} Conditions needing more evidence: ${workflow.conditionSummary.needsEvidenceCount} Average filing readiness: ${workflow.conditionSummary.averageReadinessScore}% SECTION 3 â€” RECOMMENDED NEXT ACTIONS
${workflow.nextActions.map((item, i) => ` ${i + 1}. ${item}`).join('\n')} SECTION 4 â€” EVIDENCE INDEX (All source documents cross-referenced with the conditions they support)
${evidenceIndexSection} SECTION 5 â€” CONDITION ACTION PLAN (Per-condition filing lane, required forms, and evidence traceability)
${conditionActionPlan} \u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501
DISCLAIMER: This packet is an organizational aid. It does not constitute
legal advice. Consult a VSO, attorney, or accredited claims agent before
submitting to the VA.
`;
} export function buildCaseSummaryJson(workflow) { const evidenceIndex = buildEvidenceIndex(workflow.conditionRecords); return { generated: new Date().toISOString(), workflowReadiness: workflow.readiness, claimSignals: { presumptiveMatches: workflow.serviceSummary.presumptiveMatches, potentialNewClaims: workflow.potentialNewClaims.length, deniedConditions: workflow.vaSummary.deniedConditions.length, ratedConditions: workflow.vaSummary.serviceConnectedConditions.length, averageReadinessScore: workflow.conditionSummary.averageReadinessScore, claimReadyCount: workflow.conditionSummary.claimReadyCount, developingCount: workflow.conditionSummary.developingCount, needsEvidenceCount: workflow.conditionSummary.needsEvidenceCount, }, nextActions: workflow.nextActions, evidenceIndex, conditions: workflow.conditionRecords.map((item) => ({ condition: item.condition, aliases: item.aliases, recommendedLane: item.recommendedLane, requiredForms: getLaneRecommendation(item.recommendedLane).forms, actionTip: getLaneRecommendation(item.recommendedLane).tip, readinessScore: item.readinessScore, readinessState: item.readinessState, readinessReason: item.readinessReason, evidenceGaps: item.evidenceGaps, scoreFactors: item.scoreFactors, sourceEvidence: item.sourceEvidence, })), };
} export function downloadBlob(content, filename, mimeType) { const blob = new Blob([content], { type: mimeType }); const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob); const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = url; a.download = filename; document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); document.body.removeChild(a); URL.revokeObjectURL(url);

} .profile-meter-track { height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(157, 177, 194, 0.16); overflow: hidden;
} .profile-meter-fill { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #4db6ac, #f6b44c);
} .profile-page-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap;
} .profile-muted { color: var(--rf-text-muted); font-size: 0.84rem;
} .profile-card-actions { margin-top: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap;
} .profile-inline-action { min-height: 30px; padding: 0.35rem 0.65rem; border: 1px solid rgba(157, 177, 194, 0.24); border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(9, 22, 36, 0.74); color: #e5f1fb; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600;
} .profile-inline-action:hover { border-color: rgba(246, 180, 76, 0.38);
} .profile-inline-action-delete { border-color: rgba(255, 145, 145, 0.35);
} .profile-inline-action-save { border-color: rgba(77, 182, 172, 0.35);
} .app-global-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap;
} .profile-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 7px;
} .profile-list li { border: 1px solid rgba(157, 177, 194, 0.18); border-radius: 9px; background: rgba(8, 20, 32, 0.68); padding: 8px 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px;
} .profile-list span { color: var(--rf-text-muted); font-size: 0.82rem;
} .profile-list strong { color: #eaf2f8; font-size: 0.84rem;
} .profile-button-group { display: grid; gap: 7px;
} .profile-action-button { border: 1px solid rgba(157, 177, 194, 0.24); border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(9, 22, 36, 0.74); color: #e5f1fb; text-align: left; padding: 9px 10px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer;
} .profile-action-button:hover { border-color: rgba(246, 180, 76, 0.38);
} .profile-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.3rem;
} .profile-label { font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--rf-text-muted); margin-bottom: 0.15rem;
} .profile-field-error { color: var(--rf-danger); font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600;
} .profile-radio-group { display: flex; gap: 0.9rem; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap;
} .profile-radio-item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; font-size: 0.84rem; color: var(--rf-text);
} .str-input { width: 100%; padding: 0.45rem 0.65rem; font-size: 0.875rem; background: var(--rf-bg); border: 1px solid var(--rf-border); border-radius: var(--rf-radius-sm); color: var(--rf-text); transition: border-color 0.15s;
}
.str-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--rf-accent-cool);
}
.str-input:focus-visible,
.btn-primary:focus-visible,
.btn-ghost-danger:focus-visible,
.app-nav-link:focus-visible,
.dev-tab-btn:focus-visible,
.tab-btn:focus-visible,
.kb-tab-btn:focus-visible,
button:focus-visible,
a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--rf-accent); outline-offset: 2px;
}
.str-input::placeholder { color: var(--rf-text-soft);
}
.str-input:disabled,
.str-input[readonly] { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; background: var(--rf-bg-soft, var(--rf-bg));
} .btn-primary { padding: 0.5rem 1.25rem; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; border-radius: var(--rf-radius-sm); background: var(--rf-accent); color: #07131f; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s;
}
.btn-primary:hover { background: var(--rf-accent-strong); } .btn-ghost-danger { padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; border-radius: var(--rf-radius-sm); background: transparent; color: var(--rf-danger); border: 1px solid var(--rf-danger); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
}
.btn-ghost-danger:hover { background: var(--rf-danger); color: #07131f;
} .kb-detail-head h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; color: #fff;
} .kb-detail-foot { margin-top: 1rem; padding-top: 0.75rem; border-top: 1px solid rgba(157, 177, 194, 0.12);
} .kb-error { color: var(--rf-danger);

} .kb-pro-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 10px;
} .kb-pro-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-size: 0.8rem; color: #b4d7e9;
} .kb-pro-actions { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-top: 10px;
} .kb-pro-result { margin-top: 10px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px;
} .kb-pro-metrics { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px;
} .kb-pro-metric { border: 1px solid rgba(131, 169, 194, 0.28); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px; font-size: 0.78rem; color: #d9e9f4; background: rgba(11, 26, 40, 0.6);
} .kb-pro-response { white-space: pre-wrap; margin: 0; border: 1px solid rgba(131, 169, 194, 0.28); border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px; font-size: 0.8rem; color: #dce9f5; background: rgba(7, 19, 31, 0.75); max-height: 220px; overflow: auto;

.kb-year-title { font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--rf-accent); padding: 10px 2px 4px;

} .rf-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: rgba(246, 180, 76, 0.52);
} .rf-input::placeholder { color: var(--rf-text-soft);
} .rf-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed;

} from './schema.js'; function asList(value) { return Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
} function asText(value) { return String(value || '').trim();
} function normalizeKey(value) { return asText(value) .toLowerCase() .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g, ' ') .replace(/\b(left|right|bilateral|condition|disorder|pain|syndrome|injury|diagnosis|status)\b/g, ' ') .replace(/\s+/g, ' ') .trim();
} function hasTokenMatch(left, right) { const a = normalizeKey(left); const b = normalizeKey(right); if (!a || !b) return false; return a === b || a.includes(b) || b.includes(a);
} function uniqueStrings(values) { return Array.from(new Set(asList(values).map((value) => asText(value)).filter(Boolean)));
} function uniqueEvidenceRows(rows) { const seen = new Set(); return asList(rows).filter((row) => { const normalized = asText(row); const key = normalized.toLowerCase(); if (!normalized || seen.has(key)) return false; seen.add(key); return true; });
} function buildConditionLookup(records = []) { const map = new Map(); asList(records).forEach((record) => { const label = asText(record?.condition); if (!label) return; const key = normalizeKey(label); if (key && !map.has(key)) { map.set(key, label); } }); return map;
} function getWorseningConditionKeys(claimDataUnified = {}) { return new Set(asList(claimDataUnified?.derivedSignals?.worseningIndicators).map((item) => normalizeKey(item)).filter(Boolean));
} function getConfidenceLevel(score) { if (score >= 80) return 'high'; if (score >= 55) return 'medium'; return 'low';
} function getConditionConfidenceScore(condition) { const direct = Number(condition?.confidenceScore); if (Number.isFinite(direct)) return direct; const nested = Number(condition?.confidence?.score); if (Number.isFinite(nested)) return nested; const level = asText(condition?.confidence || condition?.confidence?.level).toLowerCase(); if (level === 'high') return 90; if (level === 'medium') return 70; return 40;
} function getConditionConfidenceLevel(condition) { const level = asText(condition?.confidence || condition?.confidence?.level).toLowerCase(); if (level === 'high' || level === 'medium' || level === 'low') { return level; } return getConfidenceLevel(getConditionConfidenceScore(condition));
} function getCategory(record, worseningKeys) { const conditionKey = normalizeKey(record?.condition); const hasSecondary = asList(record?.secondaryConnections).length > 0; const topSecondary = hasSecondary ? record.secondaryConnections[0] : null; const hasAggravationSignal = /aggravat/i.test(asText(topSecondary?.rationale)); if (record?.alreadyRated && worseningKeys.has(conditionKey)) { return CLAIM_CATEGORY.INCREASE; } if (record?.deniedPreviously) { return CLAIM_CATEGORY.REOPEN; } if (hasSecondary && hasAggravationSignal) { return CLAIM_CATEGORY.AGGRAVATION; } if (hasSecondary) { return CLAIM_CATEGORY.SECONDARY; } if (record?.presumptivePathPossible) { return CLAIM_CATEGORY.PRESUMPTIVE; } return CLAIM_CATEGORY.PRIMARY;
} function formatEvidenceReference(prefix, evidenceItem) { if (!evidenceItem || typeof evidenceItem !== 'object') { return ''; } const label = asText(evidenceItem.label); if (!label) return ''; const source = asText(evidenceItem.sourceName); const date = asText(evidenceItem.date); const summary = asText(evidenceItem.summaryText); return [ prefix, label, source ? `(${source})` : '', date ? `- ${date}` : '', summary ? `- ${summary}` : '', ].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
} function buildServiceEvidence(serviceRecords, record) { const rows = []; asList(serviceRecords).forEach((serviceRecord) => { const recordHasConditionContext = hasTokenMatch(record?.condition, serviceRecord?.exposureNotes) || hasTokenMatch(record?.condition, serviceRecord?.mos?.primary) || Boolean(serviceRecord?.combatStatus) || record?.presumptivePathPossible; if (!recordHasConditionContext) return; const branch = asText(serviceRecord?.branch); const mos = asText(serviceRecord?.mos?.primary); const exposures = uniqueStrings(serviceRecord?.likelyExposures); const hazardPay = uniqueStrings(serviceRecord?.hazardPayIndicators); const radiation = uniqueStrings(serviceRecord?.radiationOperations); if (branch || mos) { rows.push(`Service profile: ${[branch, mos].filter(Boolean).join(' / ')}`); } if (exposures.length > 0) { rows.push(`Exposure indicators: ${exposures.join(', ')}`); } if (hazardPay.length > 0) { rows.push(`Hazard pay indicators: ${hazardPay.join(', ')}`); } if (radiation.length > 0) { rows.push(`Radiation operations: ${radiation.join(', ')}`); } if (serviceRecord?.combatStatus) { rows.push('Combat status present in service records'); } }); if (record?.presumptivePathPossible) { rows.push('Presumptive pathway signal detected from service/deployment history'); } return uniqueEvidenceRows(rows);
} function buildRatingEvidence(record) { const rows = []; asList(record?.sourceEvidence?.rated).forEach((item) => { const row = formatEvidenceReference('Rated:', item); if (row) rows.push(row); }); asList(record?.sourceEvidence?.denied).forEach((item) => { const row = formatEvidenceReference('Denied:', item); if (row) rows.push(row); }); if (record?.deniedPreviously) { rows.push('Prior denial found in VA rating decision history'); } return uniqueEvidenceRows(rows);
} function buildConditionEvidence(claimDataUnified, record) { const strEvidence = uniqueEvidenceRows(asList(record?.sourceEvidence?.inService) .map((item) => formatEvidenceReference('STR:', item)) .filter(Boolean)); const treatmentEvidence = uniqueEvidenceRows(asList(record?.sourceEvidence?.current) .map((item) => formatEvidenceReference('Treatment:', item)) .filter(Boolean)); const serviceEvidence = buildServiceEvidence(claimDataUnified?.service, record); const ratingDecisionEvidence = buildRatingEvidence(record); return { str: strEvidence, treatment: treatmentEvidence, service: serviceEvidence, ratingDecision: ratingDecisionEvidence, };
} function getMissingEvidence(record, category, evidence) { const missing = []; if (asList(evidence.str).length === 0 && category !== CLAIM_CATEGORY.PRESUMPTIVE) { missing.push('In-service STR event or injury linkage'); } if (asList(evidence.treatment).length === 0) { missing.push('Current diagnosis or continuity treatment records'); } if ( (category === CLAIM_CATEGORY.SECONDARY || category === CLAIM_CATEGORY.AGGRAVATION) && !asList(record?.secondaryConnections).some((connection) => asText(connection?.primaryCondition)) ) { missing.push('Medical nexus explaining secondary/aggravation relationship'); } if (category === CLAIM_CATEGORY.REOPEN && asList(evidence.ratingDecision).length === 0) { missing.push('Prior decision context for reopened issue'); } if (category === CLAIM_CATEGORY.INCREASE && asList(evidence.treatment).length < 2) { missing.push('Updated worsening trend documentation'); } return uniqueStrings(missing);
} function getRecommendedForms(record, category) { const laneForms = asList(getLaneRecommendation(record?.recommendedLane).forms); const forms = [...laneForms]; if (category === CLAIM_CATEGORY.REOPEN) { forms.push('VA Form 20-0995 (Supplemental Claim)'); forms.push('VA Form 20-0996 (Higher-Level Review)'); } if (category === CLAIM_CATEGORY.INCREASE) { forms.push('VA Form 21-526EZ (Increased Evaluation)'); } if (category === CLAIM_CATEGORY.PRESUMPTIVE) { forms.push('VA Form 21-526EZ (PACT Act exposure section)'); } if (category === CLAIM_CATEGORY.SECONDARY || category === CLAIM_CATEGORY.AGGRAVATION) { forms.push('VA Form 21-4138 (Statement in Support of Claim)'); } return uniqueStrings(forms);

} function normalizeText(value) { return String(value || '').trim();
} function normalizeDate(value) { const text = normalizeText(value); return /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(text) ? text : '';
} /** * Map a raw condition name to the preferred VA/ICD-10 terminology. * Looks up lowercase compressed key in VA_CONDITION_ALIASES. * Returns original if no alias found. */
export function normalizeConditionName(value) { const raw = normalizeText(value); if (!raw) return ''; const lower = raw .toLowerCase() .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g, ' ') .replace(/\s+/g, ' ') .trim(); return VA_CONDITION_ALIASES[lower] || raw;

export function canonicalEntryKey(entry) { const condition = normalizeConditionName(entry?.conditionName) .toLowerCase() .replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, ' ') .replace(/\s+/g, ' ') .trim(); const provider = normalizeText(entry?.providerName) .toLowerCase() .replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, ' ') .replace(/\s+/g, ' ') .trim(); return [condition, provider].filter(Boolean).join('|') || '';

'not-allowed' : 'pointer', fontWeight: 500, transition: 'all 0.2s', }} title='Delete all STR data and allow fresh upload with updated scanner' > Clear Data </button> </div> </div> </CardSection> <CardSection title='Condition Linking' collapsible defaultExpanded> <div style={{ color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: '0.78rem' }}> Use "Convert to Condition Draft" on individual findings to push validated in-service evidence into Current Treatment. </div> </CardSection> {filteredFindings.length > 0 && ( <CardSection title='Extracted Findings'> <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: '0.65rem' }}> {filteredFindings.map((finding) => ( <FindingRow key={finding.id} finding={finding} onQuickAction={handleQuickAction} /> ))} </div> </CardSection> )} {mergedTimeline.length > 0 && ( <CardSection title='Merged Timeline'> <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: '0.4rem' }}> {mergedTimeline.map((point, index) => ( <div key={`${point.date}-${point.label}-${index}`} style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', gap: '0.65rem', borderBottom: '1px solid #1e293b', paddingBottom: '0.35rem' }}> <div style={{ color: '#e2e8f0', fontSize: '0.8rem' }}>{point.label}</div> <div style={{ color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: '0.75rem', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{point.date} Â· {getTypeLabel(point.findingType)}</div> </div> ))} </div> </CardSection> )} </div> </article> <aside className='development-rail'> <RightSideSummaryRail title='STR Workflow Summary'> <div className='development-rail-list'> <div className='development-rail-row'> <span>Total Findings</span> <strong>{allFindings.length}</strong> </div> <div className='development-rail-row'> <span>Manual Entries</span> <strong>{manualEntries.length}</strong> </div> <div className='development-rail-row'> <span>Filtered View</span> <strong>{filteredFindings.length}</strong> </div> <div className='development-rail-row'> <span>Upload Status</span> <strong>{uploading ? 'Uploading' : 'Idle'}</strong> </div> </div> <div className='development-next-actions'> <div className='rf-card-title'>Quick Actions</div> <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: '0.45rem' }}> <button type='button' onClick={() => setActiveTab('upload')} style={chipStyle(false)}>Open Upload Panel</button> <button type='button' onClick={() => setActiveTab('manual')} style={chipStyle(false)}>Open Manual Panel</button> <button type='button' onClick={() => setActiveConfidenceFilter('all')} style={chipStyle(false)}>Reset Confidence Filter</button> <button type='button' onClick={handleClearOldData} disabled={allFindings.length === 0} style={chipStyle(allFindings.length > 0)}>Clear All STR Data</button> </div> </div> </RightSideSummaryRail> </aside> </div> </div> );

}); describe('validateManualEntry', () => { it('returns errors for empty conditionName and symptomSummary', () => { const errors = validateManualEntry({ conditionName: '', symptomSummary: '' }); expect(errors.conditionName).toBeTruthy(); expect(errors.symptomSummary).toBeTruthy(); }); it('passes a complete valid entry with no errors', () => { const errors = validateManualEntry({ conditionName: 'Tinnitus', symptomSummary: 'Ringing in ears', status: 'active', }); expect(Object.keys(errors)).toHaveLength(0); }); it('returns medication errors when name or dosage is blank', () => { const errors = validateManualEntry({ conditionName: 'Tinnitus', symptomSummary: 'Ringing in ears', medications: [{ medicationName: '', dosage: '', sideEffects: '' }], }); expect(errors['medication_0_name']).toBeTruthy(); expect(errors['medication_0_dosage']).toBeTruthy(); }); it('accepts a complete medication with no errors', () => { const errors = validateManualEntry({ conditionName: 'Tinnitus', symptomSummary: 'Ringing in ears', medications: [{ medicationName: 'Metoprolol', dosage: '25mg daily', sideEffects: '' }], }); expect(errors['medication_0_name']).toBeUndefined(); expect(errors['medication_0_dosage']).toBeUndefined(); });
}); describe('dedupeManualEntries', () => { it('keeps only the first entry when conditionName and providerName match', () => { const entries = [ { conditionName: 'Tinnitus', providerName: 'VA Medical Center', symptomSummary: 'First' }, { conditionName: 'Tinnitus', providerName: 'VA Medical Center', symptomSummary: 'Duplicate' }, ]; const result = dedupeManualEntries(entries); expect(result).toHaveLength(1); expect(result[0].symptomSummary).toBe('First'); }); it('keeps distinct entries when providerName differs', () => { const entries = [ { conditionName: 'Tinnitus', providerName: 'VA Medical Center' }, { conditionName: 'Tinnitus', providerName: 'Private Clinic' }, ]; expect(dedupeManualEntries(entries)).toHaveLength(2); }); it('is case-insensitive for dedup key comparison', () => { const entries = [ { conditionName: 'TINNITUS', providerName: 'VA MEDICAL CENTER' }, { conditionName: 'tinnitus', providerName: 'va medical center' }, ]; expect(dedupeManualEntries(entries)).toHaveLength(1); }); it('returns an empty array for empty input', () => { expect(dedupeManualEntries([])).toHaveLength(0); expect(dedupeManualEntries(null)).toHaveLength(0); });
}); describe('detectWorseningTrend', () => { it('returns worsening when worseningIndicators contain negative terms', () => { const section = { extractedFindings: { worseningIndicators: ['condition is worsening', 'progressive deterioration'], medicationMentions: [], functionalLimitations: [], }, }; const { trend, indicators } = detectWorseningTrend(section); expect(trend).toBe('worsening'); expect(indicators.length).toBeGreaterThan(0); }); it('returns worsening when 4 or more medications are documented', () => { const section = { extractedFindings: { worseningIndicators: [], medicationMentions: ['Metoprolol', 'Lisinopril', 'Sertraline', 'Omeprazole'], functionalLimitations: ['Limited mobility', 'Cannot lift', 'Chronic fatigue'], }, }; const { trend } = detectWorseningTrend(section); expect(trend).toBe('worsening'); }); it('returns unknown when no signals are present', () => { const { trend } = detectWorseningTrend({}); expect(trend).toBe('unknown'); }); it('returns improving when only improving terms are present', () => { const section = { extractedFindings: { worseningIndicators: ['symptoms have improved significantly'], medicationMentions: [], functionalLimitations: [], }, }; const { trend } = detectWorseningTrend(section); expect(trend).toBe('improving'); });
}); describe('normalizeExtractionResult', () => { const mockScannerResponse = { extractionMeta: { fileName: 'treatment.pdf', pagesScanned: 3, confidence: 0.88, usedOcr: false }, data: { currentConditions: ['Tinnitus', 'Lower back pain'], functionalLimitations: ['Cannot stand longer than 30 minutes'], appointments: ['VA audiology appointment 2023-06-15'], treatments: ['Physical therapy course'], worseningConditions: ['Tinnitus worsening'], medications: ['Naproxen 500mg', 'Sertraline 50mg'], providerContinuity: ['Dr. Smith, VA audiologist'], evidenceSnippets: [], }, }; import { runDeterministicClaimEngines } from '../engine/orchestration/deterministicEnginePipeline.js'; function createVeteranProfileFixture() { return { identity: { firstName: 'Pat', lastName: 'Veteran', dateOfBirth: '1988-03-05', }, contact: { state: 'TX', }, militaryService: { records: [{ branchOfService: 'Army' }], likelyExposures: ['Burn pit'], hazardPayIndicators: ['Combat pay'], radiationExposure: [], }, medicalHistory: { inServiceDiagnoses: ['Tinnitus', 'Lower back pain'], inServiceInjuries: ['Knee strain'], inServiceEvents: ['IED blast exposure'], inServiceEntries: [{ conditionName: 'Sleep apnea', description: 'Snoring during deployment', eventDate: '2010-05-01' }], currentConditions: ['Tinnitus', 'Lower back pain', 'Sleep apnea'], currentTreatmentEntries: [ { conditionName: 'Lower back pain', providerName: 'VA', treatmentDetails: 'PT and pain management' }, ], worseningIndicators: ['Lower back pain'], presumptiveSignals: ['Sinusitis'], functionalLimitations: ['Cannot stand more than 20 minutes'], evidenceSnippets: ['Sleep study confirms obstructive sleep apnea'], }, benefits: { serviceConnectedConditions: ['Lower back pain'], deniedConditions: ['Sleep apnea'], currentRatings: [{ conditionName: 'Lower back pain', percentage: 20 }], }, derived: { benefitRelevantIssues: ['Tinnitus', 'Lower back pain', 'Sleep apnea', 'Sinusitis'], }, };
} function stable(value) { return JSON.stringify(value);
} describe('Deterministic claim engines', () => { it('benefitRelevance is deterministic across repeated runs', () => { const profile = createVeteranProfileFixture(); const first = runBenefitRelevanceEngine(profile); for (let index = 0; index < 4; index += 1) { const next = runBenefitRelevanceEngine(profile); expect(stable(next)).toEqual(stable(first)); } expect(first._audit?.deterministic).toBe(true); }); it('formReadiness is deterministic across repeated runs', () => { const profile = createVeteranProfileFixture(); const relevance = runBenefitRelevanceEngine(profile); const first = runFormReadinessEngine(profile, relevance); for (let index = 0; index < 4; index += 1) { const next = runFormReadinessEngine(profile, relevance); expect(stable(next)).toEqual(stable(first)); } expect(first._audit?.engine).toBe('formReadinessEngine'); }); it('evidenceAnalyzer and cfrAlignment are deterministic across repeated runs', () => { const profile = createVeteranProfileFixture(); const relevance = runBenefitRelevanceEngine(profile); const readiness = runFormReadinessEngine(profile, relevance); const evidenceFirst = runEvidenceAnalyzerEngine(profile, relevance); const cfrFirst = runCfrAlignmentEngine(profile, relevance, evidenceFirst, readiness); for (let index = 0; index < 4; index += 1) { const evidenceNext = runEvidenceAnalyzerEngine(profile, relevance); const cfrNext = runCfrAlignmentEngine(profile, relevance, evidenceNext, readiness); expect(stable(evidenceNext)).toEqual(stable(evidenceFirst)); expect(stable(cfrNext)).toEqual(stable(cfrFirst)); } expect(evidenceFirst._audit?.engine).toBe('evidenceAnalyzerEngine'); expect(cfrFirst._audit?.engine).toBe('cfrAlignmentEngine'); }); it('deterministic engine pipeline returns stable output and trace metadata', () => { const profile = createVeteranProfileFixture(); const first = runDeterministicClaimEngines(profile); for (let index = 0; index < 4; index += 1) { const next = runDeterministicClaimEngines(profile); expect(stable(next)).toEqual(stable(first)); } expect(first._enginePipeline?.deterministic).toBe(true); expect(first._enginePipeline?.stages?.map((item) => item.name)).toEqual([ 'benefitRelevance', 'formReadiness', 'evidenceAnalyzer', 'cfrAlignment', ]); });

expect(result.exposures.some((e) => /combat/i.test(e))).toBe(true); }); it('radiationExposure as array on service record adds radiation exposure', () => { const result = runDerivedSignalsEngine({ // radiationExposure must be an array of strings (not a boolean) service: [{ radiationExposure: ['nuclear weapons test site'], hazardPayIndicators: [], deploymentLocations: [], combatVeteran: false }], }); expect(result.exposures.some((e) => /camp lejeune/i.test(e))).toBe(true); });
}); // â”€â”€ Derived Signals Engine: Presumptives â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ describe('Derived Signals Engine â€” Presumptives', () => { it('burn pit exposure generates respiratory presumptive conditions', () => { const result = runDerivedSignalsEngine({ service: [{ hazardPayIndicators: ['burn pits'], deploymentLocations: [], combatVeteran: false }], }); const burnPitConditions = EXPOSURE_CONDITION_MAP['burn pits'] || []; const hasAtLeastOne = burnPitConditions.some((cond) => result.presumptives.some((p) => p.toLowerCase().includes(cond.toLowerCase())) ); expect(hasAtLeastOne).toBe(true); }); it('agent orange exposure generates diabetes mellitus type 2 as presumptive', () => { const result = runDerivedSignalsEngine({ service: [{ hazardPayIndicators: ['agent orange'], deploymentLocations: [], combatVeteran: false }], }); expect(result.presumptives.some((p) => /diabetes/i.test(p))).toBe(true); }); it('STR presumptiveSignals pass through to presumptives', () => { const result = runDerivedSignalsEngine({ str: { extractedFindings: { presumptiveSignals: ['ischemic heart disease'], diagnoses: [], injuries: [], events: [] }, }, }); expect(result.presumptives.some((p) => /ischemic heart/i.test(p))).toBe(true); }); it('hazardous noise exposure produces tinnitus and hearing loss as presumptives', () => { const result = runDerivedSignalsEngine({ service: [{ hazardPayIndicators: ['hazardous noise'], deploymentLocations: [], combatVeteran: false }], }); const noiseConditions = EXPOSURE_CONDITION_MAP['hazardous noise'] || []; const hasAtLeastOne = noiseConditions.some((cond) => result.presumptives.some((p) => p.toLowerCase().includes(cond.toLowerCase())) ); expect(hasAtLeastOne).toBe(true); });
